description: Swing report package executor settings (#15724). Each video is one native_viewer_export subprocess run with its own temporary folder, wiped after the run (a render stages several GB of raw frames). 'min_free_gb' is checked before every render; 'render_timeout_s' bounds one render. 'phase_bodies' names the model body standing for each phase point other than 'grip' (midway between the hands) and 'clubhead' (the face centre), which come from the exporter's club model; key phases use the bundle's reference swing. 'cli_defaults' are the command line's swing name and club label.
